state_transitions.reason: swarm_audit: test fixtures use wrong ID format (proj-001 vs P[0-9]{3}), 14+ tests should be failing (SW-001)
swarm_audit: userId authorization only enforced in 2/9 routers — fix incomplete (SW-002)
swarm_audit: WebSocket accepts anonymous connections, broadcasts all events to all clients without userId filtering (SW-003)
swarm_audit: 8/10 session router endpoints lack userId authorization (SW-010)
swarm_audit: ClaudeProvider hardcodes bypassPermissions:true, overrides user config (SW-009)

swarm_audit: auto-mode uses hardcoded userId 'auto-mode', sessions not tied to real users (SW-012)

new_backlog_items.title: Fix userId authorization in 7 remaining API routers
new_backlog_items.description: Session, agent, learning, settings, notifications, worktree, and terminal routers need userId scoping on all endpoints. Add findByUser() to session repository. Model after feature/project router pattern.

new_backlog_items.title: Fix WebSocket authentication — reject anonymous connections
new_backlog_items.description: Remove anonymous fallback in extractWsUserId. Reject WebSocket upgrade if auth fails. Add per-user event filtering in EventBroadcaster.

new_backlog_items.title: Fix ClaudeProvider bypassPermissions override
new_backlog_items.description: ClaudeProvider should respect the permissionMode from AgentConfig instead of hardcoding bypassPermissions:true.

new_backlog_items.title: Fix agent sendMessage ownership check
new_backlog_items.description: Add userId ownership verification to agent.sendMessage, agent.getHistory, agent.clearHistory, agent.listSessions. Follow the pattern used in agent.stop.

new_backlog_items.title: Fix auto-mode userId to use actual user context
new_backlog_items.description: Auto-mode service should accept and use the requesting user's ID instead of hardcoded 'auto-mode'. Feature queue should be scoped to user's features.

new_backlog_items.title: Fix F004 project test fixtures to use P[0-9]{3} format
new_backlog_items.description: Update test fixture minimalValidProject to use id: 'P001' instead of 'proj-001'. Verify all 14+ test cases pass with correct ID format.

new_backlog_items.title: Fix CSP header to whitelist Scalar CDN
new_backlog_items.description: Add https://cdn.jsdelivr.net to script-src directive in CSP header at apps/server/src/index.ts:77-78, or bundle @scalar/api-reference locally.

new_backlog_items.title: Fix test runner alignment — bun:test vs vitest
new_backlog_items.description: Align test runner across all packages. Either convert all tests to vitest or ensure bun test is the CI runner. Current mismatch means tests may not run in automated pipelines.

new_backlog_items.title: Upgrade rate limiter for production readiness
new_backlog_items.description: Add TTL/cleanup to in-memory rate limit store. Consider WebSocket rate limiting. Don't trust x-forwarded-for without trusted proxy config.

new_backlog_items.title: Add apps/web to root tsconfig references
new_backlog_items.description: Add apps/web to the references array in root tsconfig.json so root-level tsc --build checks the web app.

new_antipatterns.name: partial_auth_fix
new_antipatterns.description: Applying authorization fixes to some routers but not others. F224 fixed feature + project routers but left 7 other routers unprotected.
new_antipatterns.example: Session, agent, learning, settings, notifications, worktree routers missing userId checks while feature + project routers are properly secured
new_antipatterns.impact: Creates false sense of security — feature appears fixed but most endpoints remain vulnerable

new_antipatterns.name: anonymous_websocket_fallback
new_antipatterns.description: WebSocket auth that falls back to 'anonymous' on failure instead of rejecting the connection
new_antipatterns.example: extractWsUserId defaults to 'anonymous' when session extraction fails
new_antipatterns.impact: Unauthenticated clients can establish persistent connections and receive all broadcast events

new_antipatterns.name: hardcoded_permission_bypass
new_antipatterns.description: SDK/provider code that hardcodes permissionMode to bypassPermissions regardless of user configuration
new_antipatterns.example: ClaudeProvider always sets bypassPermissions:true in SDK options
new_antipatterns.impact: Agent runs with full filesystem access even when user configured restricted permissions

new_antipatterns.name: test_runner_mismatch
new_antipatterns.description: Tests written for one test runner (bun:test) but CI configured for another (vitest). Tests exist but never execute.
new_antipatterns.example: packages/types tests use bun:test imports but vitest is the configured runner
new_antipatterns.impact: Broken tests go undetected, giving false confidence in code quality
